thread:
Ishaan (oncall): Noticed rising 503s and stream resets on hosted edge in ap-southeast starting ~03:34 UTC. Looks related to HTTP/2 connection errors on gateway-proxy. Opening an incident doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INC/1967123456.
SRE Bot: Alert: edge.proxy.http2_reset_rate > 2% (region=ap-southeast). Dash: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/proxy/http2-resets?from=now-30m
Kyra (infra): Rolling up: we pushed proxy v1.12.0 yesterday which enabled connection reuse optimizations. I'm seeing long-lived connections accumulating FD counts and `GOAWAY` from some backends. Triggering a rolling restart of proxy nodes in ap-southeast now.
Tomas (eng-runtime): Runtime note: some model backends don't handle GOAWAY gracefully and we see a cascade where the proxy retries streams, exhausting pools and hitting 503 fallbacks. We can temporarily set `proxy.http2.max_concurrent_streams=50` and `proxy.http2.idle_timeout=30s` to reduce pressure.
Priya (support): Customer impact: 5 active tickets so far, two enterprise customers (ShopGo, EduSoft) reported interrupted realtime sessions. CS is sending interim guidance (refresh client backoff and resume streams).
Kyra (infra): Restart of proxy node group started 03:42 UTC; rolling at 1 node/min. Monitoring FD and reset rates.
SRE Bot: Post-action: http2_reset_rate dropped ~60% after first 3 nodes restarted. Tracking across all zones.
Tomas (eng-runtime): Applied temporary config changes to reduce concurrent streams and lowered pool reuse TTL. Also enabled an HTTP/1.1 fallback for clients that repeatedly fail HTTP/2 negotiation.
Ishaan (oncall): ETA for full convergence ~10-15m. Avoid deploying new proxy or runtime changes while rolling restarts finish.
Priya (support): Notified ShopGo & EduSoft with targeted status (they have long-lived realtime connections). Links to troubleshooting: https://support.redwood.ai/kb/realtime-retries.
Kyra (infra): All proxy restarts completed in ap-southeast at 03:57 UTC. Metrics show resets back to baseline by 04:01.
Tomas (eng-runtime): Preliminary RCA: proxy v1.12.0's aggressive connection reuse + some backend model servers not handling GOAWAY led to connection leaks and pool exhaustion. Plan: revert the reuse heuristic, add GOAWAY handling tests, and add an automated alarm for FD growth on gateway nodes.
Ishaan (oncall): Published status update: "Intermittent 503s and stream resets in ap-southeast due to HTTP/2 connection reuse regression; mitigation applied and service recovered. Postmortem and customer notes forthcoming." Posting to status.redwood.ai now.
StatusBot: Status page updated: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1967123456
Ishaan (oncall): Marking incident mitigated. Action items on incident doc: revert reuse heuristic, add e2e GOAWAY test, FD growth alert, targeted customer follow-ups. If anyone sees new spikes, ping here. :white_check_mark:
